Container.Name: photostead-demo
Container.Overview: The App Review demo server: a second Photostead with the website's demo household, apart from the household's own. Reached as https://demo.photostead.com through a Cloudflare Tunnel. Uploads are answered and thrown away. Made by deploy/unraid/demo-on-unraid.sh.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The demo's web app and API

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, the demo's photos, thumbnails and previews

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_BACKUP_DIR
Config.Description: No nightly database copies (the clean copy is the backup)

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The address App Review reaches it at

Config.Name: PHOTOSTEAD_DISCARD_UPLOADS
Config.Description: on: uploads are answered as filed, then thrown away (off only to load the demo household)
